# Page

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Contains the body, header, footer, and background elements for one document page.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Page(width: LengthInput, height: LengthInput, margin: LengthInput, options?: PageOptions)
new Page(pageSize: PdfSize, margin: LengthInput, options?: PageOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`contentHeight`](#contentheight): Gets the available content height (page height minus margins)
- [`contentWidth`](#contentwidth): Gets the available content width (page width minus margins)
- [`height`](#height): Gets the page height in points
- [`margin`](#margin): The page margin on every side, in points.
- [`margins`](#margins): Optional four-sided margin, taking precedence over the uniform margin.
- [`pageBackground`](#pagebackground): Full-page background element for this page only (drawn behind all content, ignoring margins).
- [`pageColor`](#pagecolor): Page background fill.
- [`pageForeground`](#pageforeground): Full-page foreground element for this page only (drawn on top of all content, ignoring margins).
- [`size`](#size): The page size, in points.
- [`width`](#width): Gets the page width in points

### `pageBackground`

```typescript
pageBackground?: IElement | undefined
```

*optional*

Full-page background element for this page only (drawn behind all content, ignoring margins). When set, the pipeline renders this element instead of calling [`DocumentSettings.pageBackground`](document-settings.md#pagebackground) for this page (and any continuation pages its content overflows onto). Useful for per-page letterhead, cover images, or section dividers. Leave undefined to fall back to the document-level `pageBackground` template.

### `pageColor`

```typescript
pageColor: Color | undefined
```

Page background fill. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `pageForeground`

```typescript
pageForeground?: IElement | undefined
```

*optional*

Full-page foreground element for this page only (drawn on top of all content, ignoring margins). When set, the pipeline renders this element instead of calling [`DocumentSettings.pageForeground`](document-settings.md#pageforeground) for this page (and any continuation pages). Useful for per-page "DRAFT"/"CONFIDENTIAL" overlays. Leave undefined to fall back to the document-level `pageForeground` template.
